content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-restriction language exists anywhere in the document. Article VII (servicer transition) contains only cooperation, records-transfer and IP/process carve-outs — no restriction on our hiring Cellco servicing personnel.

input.quote: The Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
input.rationale:
Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce" return no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant anywhere in the Agreement. Article VII (Servicer Resignation and Termination; Successor Servicer), including the transition provisions in Sections 7.4 and 7.5, imposes only cooperation and records/funds-transfer duties on the outgoing Servicer, plus a carve-out preserving Cellco's proprietary processes and software; nothing restricts the Issuer, the Depositor, the Indenture Trustee or any Successor Servicer from soliciting or hiring Cellco servicing personnel on a transition. Article IX (Other Agreements) likewise contains no restrictive covenant of this kind. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit binding our party), so no redline is proposed.</parationale>
